debug.notes: Debug mode: false = only important logs (startup, gate crossing, warnings, mode changes), true = verbose frame processing logs. ALWAYS SHOWN: startup (✅🚪⏱️🎯🚂📹), gate crossing (🚦🚪), warnings (⚠️), mode changes (🔄⏸️). SUPPRESSED when false: YOLO pause/resume verbose (🔇🔊)

locomotive_colors.notes: Hex color codes for locomotive visualization (RGB format). Used in video feed markers, analytics charts, and UI badges. Backend auto-converts to BGR for OpenCV.

10.name: C10 Interno
10.notes: Asymmetric gate timing: only L5@G3-L1@G4 valid (figure-8 track geometry). Reference=D645 014 (ESU stable), Adjust=Gr.675 017 (ESU LokSound).

11.name: C11 Esterno
11.notes: Symmetric cross-gate timing: both L7@G1-L8@G2 and L7@G2-L8@G1 valid (oval track). Reference=E444 056 (ESU stable, NEVER touch), Adjust=E656 239 (Hornby).

fps.notes: Tracking FPS (active/idle) and video feed stream FPS

tracking.notes_idle_timeout: Seconds of inactivity (all locomotives stopped) before switching to idle mode (1 FPS) and ending analytics session

timing_thresholds.notes: Thresholds in seconds: |Δt| < normal = SYNCED, normal-warning = WARNING, > warning = CRITICAL, > max_delta_t = ignored (outlier from video lag)

tracking.notes_yolo: YOLO confidence threshold (0.0-1.0), IoU threshold for NMS (0.0-1.0, higher = allows more bbox overlap), inference image size (640 for square models, [640, 1152] for rectangular), and yolo_obb (true = Oriented Bounding Boxes for rotated objects, false = standard axis-aligned boxes)
